youtube.title: Why Does Your Vision Go Black When You Stand? 😵 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
When you sit or lie down, blood spreads evenly through your body. Standing up, gravity pulls blood toward your legs and less returns to the heart, so less reaches the brain for a moment. Your body quickly corrects this by tightening blood vessels and speeding up your heartbeat.
